messages.text: What is OFDM, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

OFDM is described here as an OFDM-symbol-based waveform structure: a cyclic prefix is added to each raw OFDM symbol by copying the last samples to the front, creating a guard interval between OFDM symbols to reduce inter-symbol interference [13]. In NR, the time-domain OFDM symbols and frequency-domain subcarriers form the resource grid; one resource element is one subcarrier in one OFDM symbol on one antenna port [19]. NR sample rate is determined by the OFDM FFT size and subcarrier spacing: sampling rate = NFFT × SCS, with SCS = 2^μ × 15 kHz [16]. OFDM also matters for transmitter behavior because OFDM signals have high PAPR due to the IFFT linear combination of many random QAM symbols, which can require PA back-off to avoid clipping/distortion [27].
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding OFDM
| Decision | Rohde & Schwarz context | What depends on OFDM knowledge | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| WLAN generator/analyzer option selection | R&S CMW100-K06 WLAN options | Choosing the correct WLAN OFDM generator/analyzer option: 802.11a/g/p/n OFDM via R&S CMW-KW650, 802.11ac via CMW-KW656, 802.11ax via CMW-KW657; analyzer options include CMW-KM650/KM651/KM655/KM656/KM657 [24]. | [24] |
| WLAN bandwidth and MIMO measurement setup | R&S CMW100-K06 WLAN OFDM RF analyzer | Selecting analyzer bandwidths—20 MHz, 40 MHz, 80 MHz, 80+80 MHz, or 160 MHz depending on WLAN standard—and MIMO mode up to 8×8, including switched/composite MIMO options [24]. | [24] |
| NR sample-rate / numerology setup | NR waveform configuration used in R&S NR test context | Selecting NFFT and subcarrier spacing, because NR sample rate follows NFFT × SCS and SCS follows 2^μ × 15 kHz [16]. | [16] |
| CP / slot-symbol configuration | NR frame-structure measurements | Choosing Normal CP vs Extended CP changes OFDM symbols per slot: Normal CP uses 14 OFDM symbols per slot, Extended CP uses 12; Release 15 Extended CP is only defined for μ=2 [18]. | [18] |
| Resource-grid / allocation decisions | NR measurements and resource mapping | Understanding that an RE is one subcarrier in one OFDM symbol and one antenna port, and that RBs are 12 consecutive subcarriers, is needed for resource-grid allocation and measurement interpretation [19]. | [19] |
| OCNG allocation implementation choices | Internal R&S OCNG mapper notes, not public product spec | OCNG allocation includes configurable OFDM symbol allocation per slot, start OFDM symbol, number of symbols, PRB start/length, power setting, and RB-list/header fields including a 14-bit OFDM symbol mask [2][3]. | [2][3] |
| PT-RS density/configuration decisions | NR PDSCH/PUSCH PT-RS configuration | PT-RS density guidance applies to PDSCH/PUSCH in normal OFDM with transform precoding disabled; time density uses 1, 2, or 4 OFDM-symbol spacing, and frequency density uses 2 or 4 RB spacing [30][31][33]. | [30][31][33] |
| UL waveform / PA-efficiency decisions | NR/LTE UL waveform behavior | DFT-s-OFDM/transform precoding is used in LTE and NR UL to obtain low-PAPR UL transmit signals; low PAPR can let the UE PA operate closer to saturation and improve efficiency [26][27]. | [26][27] |
| CMX500 NR/LTE RF test planning | R&S CMX500 | CMX500 is a Rohde & Schwarz radio communication tester and one-box network emulation/measurement solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, RF parametric testing, and fading conditions [4]. | [4] |

The provided RAW passages do not state the OFDM definition or any R&S OFDM product-option specifications; the only RAW product-context evidence supplied is a brochure pointer and a product-manager contact [39][40].

OCNG mapper › 使用限制
- 本頁整理的是 Rohde & Schwarz company confidential 技術筆記中的 implementation notes，不代表公開 3GPP 規格要求或產品規格。
- Work Item 632178 與 Epic 686215 僅以內部 ID 出現，未提供狀態、系統或日期。
- Header format 只依 lossy markdown 轉檔保存，正式 FPGA / PHY SW implementation 需回內部設計文件。
- 來源中的 modulation type 欄位不代表 3GPP OCNG data region 已允許 QAM16 / QAM64 / QAM256；來源同時指出 specification only specifies pseudo random QPSK。

OCNG mapper › 需求摘要
[[OCNG (NR)]] 將 NR OCNG RE mapper 的需求整理如下：

- Configurable bandwidth with [[Resource Block]] resolution，supports OCNG Pattern 3 and 5。
- Start PRB and length of PRBs：0–272 and 1–273 ranges respectively。
- Configurable [[OFDM symbol]] allocation per slot，supports OCNG Pattern 4。
- Start OFDM symbol and number of symbols：0–13 and 1–14 ranges respectively。
- Power setting for OCNG allocation, similar to [[PDSCH]] format。
- Selectable awareness of other antenna's reference symbols，supports OCNG Pattern 2 and 5。
- Awareness of other antenna reference symbols implemented with extra [[CSI-RS]] allocation with zero-power。
- Data Region OCNG must be sourced from RDRAM。
- OCNG REs must be allocated last, and with lowest priority。

來源中曾提出 selectable modulation format 的問題，但也寫明 specification only specifies pseudo random [[QPSK]] modulated data；因此規格層主張仍是 QPSK。

OCNG mapper › Header / allocation format 線索
來源列出 allocation header 的可辨識欄位：

| Word | 欄位 | 來源描述 |
|---:|---|---|
| 0 | pointer / header type | next header element pointer；header type 14 = OCNG；invalid = 0xF |
| 1 | priority / number of RBs | priority 1 low to 15 high，0 not allowed；Number of RBs 1..273 |
| 2 | OFDM symbol mask | 14-bit OFDM symbol mask |
| 3 | OCNG Power factor | 0x8000 = 1 |
| 4/5 | data pointer / RAM / layers / modulation | OCNG Data pointer；RAM Select 0=PDRAM, 1=FDRAM, 3=RDRAM default；Number of layers / ports minus 1 range 0 to 3；Modulation Type 2=QPSK, 3=QAM16, 4=QAM64, 5=QAM256 |

來源也說 RB List extension elements provide a list of PRB numbers in the order of mapping：

- At least one RB set is required to provide overall OCNG mapping。
- At least one RB is required。
- Each extension element can hold up to 16 RB numbers。
- More extension elements can be added if more RB numbers are needed。
- Unused words in the last extension element should be set to 0xFFFF。
- Number of RBs in the header must match number of RBs in the RB list。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMX500 › 文件依據與版次
本頁並列使用兩份來源：

| 來源 | 文件類型 | 文件編號 | 版次 / 軟體 | 日期 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] | Features and Functions | 1179.1164.02 | Version 32；CSW 9.20.0 and higher | 來源未標示；© 2026 | GUI、software features、signaling / application / measurement options 與使用介面 |

[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 的 product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後，warm-up operation 30 分鐘；符合指定 environmental conditions；遵守 recommended calibration interval；已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。文件區分 specifications with limits、non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 與 uncertainties；non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 擔保。

R&S CMX500 › Warranty and service
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]：

- All other items warranty：1 year。
- Calibration service plans：up to five years；on demand 為 pay per calibration。

NTN test and measurement aspects › OTA / phased array / PAAM testing
NTN UE、VSAT、SAN、satellite 可能使用 directive antennas / phased array antennas，因此 OTA testing 重要。

NR cyclic prefix › 基本概念
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- 在 OFDM system 中，CP is added for each OFDM symbol in time-domain。
- CP 是把 raw OFDM symbol 最後幾個 samples 複製到 raw OFDM symbol 前方。
- CP provides a guard interval between two OFDM symbols。
- CP 用於 eliminate inter-symbol interference, ISI。
- NR defines two types of cyclic prefix lengths：[[Normal CP]] 與 [[Extended CP]]。

NR cyclic prefix › Normal CP
[[Normal CP]] 是 normal short length CP：

- 用於 short delay spread environment。
- 14 [[OFDM symbol]]s per slot。
- 來源說 standard CP length of most OFDM symbols is 9/128 × NFFT，approximately 7 percent redundancy overhead。
- CP of the first OFDM symbol of every half-subframe is longer than all others，以 compensate inequality。

來源列出的 NCP 標準 CP duration：

| μ | Raw OFDM symbol duration | Standard CP duration | Long CP duration | Delay spread estimate |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0 | 66.667 μs | 4.6875 μs | 5.2083 μs | 1406 m |
| 1 | 33.333 μs | 2.3438 μs | 2.8646 μs | 703 m |
| 2 | 16.667 μs | 1.1719 μs | 1.6927 μs | 351.6 m |
| 3 | 8.333 μs | 0.5859 μs | 1.1067 μs | 175.8 m |
| 4 | 4.167 μs | 0.2930 μs | 0.8138 μs | 87.9 m |

NR cyclic prefix › Extended CP
[[Extended CP]] 是 extended longer length CP：

- 用於 long delay spread environment。
- 12 [[OFDM symbol]]s per slot。
- CP length is same for all OFDM symbols。
- CP length = NFFT / 4。
- 來源說 this means 25 percent redundancy overhead。
- 來源明示：In NR Release 15 the ECP is only defined for numerology μ=2。

來源列出的 ECP CP duration 線索：

| μ | Raw OFDM symbol duration | CP duration | OFDM symbol incl. CP | Slot duration | Delay spread estimate |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0 | 66.667 μs | 16.667 μs | 83.333 μs | 1000 μs | 5000 m |
| 1 | 33.333 μs | 8.333 μs | 41.667 μs | 500 μs | 2500 m |
| 2 | 16.667 μs | 4.167 μs | 20.833 μs | 250 μs | 1250 m |
| 3 | 8.333 μs | 2.083 μs | 10.417 μs | 125 μs | 625 m |
| 4 | 4.167 μs | 1.042 μs | 5.208 μs | 62.5 μs | 312.5 m |

注意：雖然來源表中列出多個 μ 的 ECP duration，來源同頁明示 NR Release 15 ECP only defined for μ=2；因此不可把表格直接解讀為所有 μ 在 Release 15 均可用。

NR sample rate › Sample rate 公式
來源給出的 NR sample rate calculation：

- Sampling rate in samples/sec = number of samples per raw OFDM symbol / duration of one raw OFDM symbol。
- Sampling rate = NFFT / (1 / SCS)。
- Sampling rate = NFFT × SCS。
- SCS = 2^μ × 15 kHz。
- 因此 sampling rate = NFFT × 2^μ × 15 kHz。

NR sample rate
[[NR sample rate]] 是 5G NR OFDM waveform 中由 NFFT 與 [[Subcarrier Spacing]] 決定的 sampling rate；[[NR Frame Structure]] 以 [[3GPP TS 38.211]] chapter 4.1 的 Tc 定義為起點說明。

5G NR frame structure › OFDM symbols per slot
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- [[Normal CP]] 使用 14 [[OFDM symbol]]s per slot。
- [[Extended CP]] 使用 12 [[OFDM symbol]]s per slot。
- 來源明示在 NR Release 15 中，[[Extended CP]] only defined for numerology μ=2。

5G NR frame structure › 與 resource grid 的關係
Frame / subframe / slot / symbol 是 time-domain structure；[[NR resource grid]] 則把 time-domain [[OFDM symbol]] 與 frequency-domain subcarriers 組成 grid。

- [[Resource Element]] 是 one subcarrier in one OFDM symbol and on one antenna port。
- [[Resource Block]] 是 12 consecutive subcarriers。
- [[Point-A]] 是 resource grid starts toward higher frequencies 的 frequency-domain reference。

NR Frame Structure › 重點摘要
- 來源是一份 Rohde & Schwarz company confidential 技術筆記，題名為 **NR Frame Structure**；raw 轉檔日期為 2026-09-24，但原始文件未標示正式發布日期、作者或文件版次。
- 來源指出 [[5G NR frame structure]] mainly defined in [[3GPP TS 38.211]] chapter 4；未標示 [[3GPP TS 38.211]] 的 version、release 或 publication date。
- [[5G NR frame structure]] 中，NR frame duration 固定為 10 ms，且包含 10 個 consecutive subframes，每個 subframe duration 為 1 ms。
- [[5G NR numerology]] μ 定義 OFDM time-frequency resolution；NR reference SCS μ=0 為 15 kHz，與 LTE 相同。μ 越高，time resolution 越高，但 frequency resolution 越低。
- 來源列出 μ=0 到 μ=4 的 [[Subcarrier Spacing]]、slots per subframe、slots per frame 與 average slot duration：15/30/60/120/240 kHz，對應 1/2/4/8/16 slots per subframe。
- [[NR sample rate]] 依 [[3GPP TS 38.211]] chapter 4.1 的最小時間單位 Tc = 1 / (480 kHz × 4096) = 508.63 ps；最高 possible sample rate foreseen by specification 為 1966.08 MS/s。
- 來源給出 NR sampling rate 公式：sampling rate = NFFT × SCS = NFFT × 2^μ × 15 kHz。
- 來源指出 sample rates above 491.52 MS/s are currently unrealistic, not really needed and ignored for now；並列出 30.72 到 1966.08 MS/s 對應 maximum bandwidth 25 到 1600 MHz。
- [[NR cyclic prefix]] 分為 [[Normal CP]] 與 [[Extended CP]]。NCP 為 short CP，14 OFDM symbols per slot；ECP 為 longer CP，12 OFDM symbols per slot。
- 來源明示在 NR Release 15 中，[[Extended CP]] only defined for numerology μ=2。
- [[Resource Element]] 定義為 one subcarrier in one OFDM symbol and on one antenna port。
- [[Resource Block]] 定義為 frequency domain 中 12 consecutive subcarriers；來源列出 RB bandwidth 對 μ=0..4 為 180、360、720、1440、2880 kHz。
- [[Point-A]] 是 frequency domain 的 common reference point，為 resource grid starts toward higher frequencies 的 absolute frequency，且指 resource grid 第一個 subcarrier 的 center frequency。

NR Frame Structure › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[3GPP TS 38.211]] — 來源指出 NR frame structure mainly defined in chapter 4，但未提供標準版本。
- [[5G NR frame structure]] — frame、subframe、slot 與 OFDM symbol 的時間架構。
- [[5G NR numerology]] — μ、SCS、slots per subframe 與 slot duration 的關係。
- [[Subcarrier Spacing]] — 來源列出 μ=0..4 對應 15、30、60、120、240 kHz。
- [[OFDM symbol]] — FFT size、raw OFDM symbol、CP 與 symbol duration 的核心語彙。
- [[NR sample rate]] — Tc、Ts、NFFT、SCS、sample rate 與 maximum bandwidth 的關係。
- [[NR cyclic prefix]] — [[Normal CP]] 與 [[Extended CP]] 的總稱。
- [[Normal CP]] — short CP，14 OFDM symbols per slot，standard CP duration 約為 9/128 × NFFT。
- [[Extended CP]] — longer CP，12 OFDM symbols per slot，CP length = NFFT/4；Release 15 only defined for μ=2。
- [[NR resource grid]] — resource element、resource block 與 Point-A 的 frequency-domain grid 概念。
- [[Resource Element]] — one subcarrier × one OFDM symbol × one antenna port。
- [[Resource Block]] — 12 consecutive subcarriers。
- [[Point-A]] — resource grid 的 absolute frequency reference。

NR Frame Structure › 與既有知識的關係
- [[3GPP TS 38.211]] 既有頁面已收錄 [[CSI-RS]] 與 [[DMRS]] 對 TS 38.211 sections / tables 的引用；本來源新增 chapter 4 的 frame structure、numerology、sample rate、CP 與 resource grid 索引。
- [[UE channel bandwidth]] 與 [[Maximum transmission bandwidth configuration]] 已依 [[Frequency Ranges, Bands and Bandwidth]] 保存 channel bandwidth、sample rate 與 N_RB 線索；本來源補充較底層的 Tc、Ts、NFFT × SCS sample-rate calculation 與 cyclic prefix sample distribution。
- [[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]] 與 [[FR2-2]] 是 frequency range / carrier bandwidth 分類；本來源不是 frequency-band 清單，而是 physical layer frame / OFDM grid structure 的基礎說明。
- [[Demodulation Reference Signals (DMRS)]] 與 [[CSI-RS]] 使用 [[Resource Element]] / [[Resource Block]] / [[OFDM symbol]] grid concepts；本來源可作為這些 reference signal resource mapping 的背景頁。

R&S CMW100 K06 › 規格資料的使用限制
[[CMW100-K06_specs_en_5214-8348-22_v0500]] 對規格類型定義如下：

- Specifications with limits 代表 warranted product performance，以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、minimum 等標示。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits 標示為 n. trc.，因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，產品性能不保證。
- Specifications without limits 代表指定參數的 warranted product performance，通常為 dimensions 或 setting parameter resolution 等無偏差或偏差可忽略的值。
- Typical data 標示為 typ.，若標示為 `<`、`>` 或 range，代表生產時約 80% instruments 可達到的 performance；否則代表 mean value。
- Nominal values 標示為 nom.，不進行 statistical evaluation，生產時不測試該參數。
- Measured values 標示為 meas.，以個別 samples 的 measurement results 描述 expected product performance。
- Uncertainties 以 coverage factor 2 定義，依 GUM 規則計算，納入 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 保證。
- Data without tolerance limits is not binding；Subject to change。

Low-PAPR sequence › Transform precoding 與 π/2-BPSK
依 [[DMRS]]：

- [[DFT-s-OFDM]] 也稱為 [[Transform precoding]]，在 LTE 與 NR 的 UL 中啟用，用於取得 low-PAPR UL transmit signal。
- Transform precoding 中 modulation symbols 先經 DFT-precoded，再輸入 OFDM modulator。
- DFT 與 OFDM modulator 的 IFFT block effectively cancels one another，因此移除 OFDM modulator 的 high-PAPR effect。
- 使用 low-PAPR modulation symbols 可進一步降低 UL transmit signal 的 PAPR。
- NR 中 UL transmission with transform precoding 啟用 [[π-2-BPSK]] modulation。
- [[π-2-BPSK]] 產生 low-PAPR waveform，因為 symbol-to-symbol transition 不會穿越 constellation 的 zero-amplitude point。

Low-PAPR sequence › 背景：為什麼需要 low-PAPR
依 [[DMRS]]：

- OFDM signals 具有 high peak-to-average power ratio（PAPR），因為由 many random QAM symbols 的 linear combination（IFFT）形成。
- High-PAPR signal 需要 transmitter back-off power amplifier operating point，以避免 transmit signal 進入 power amplifier saturation region 而 clipped / distorted。
- Power amplifier 遠離 saturation point 操作時 efficiency drops。
- DL signals 由連接 power grid 的 base station 傳送，因此 high-PAPR 在 DL 不 critical；NR uses OFDM for DL signals。
- NR 與 LTE 不同，NR UL 也允許使用 OFDM signals。
- UL 可能需要 low-PAPR signal，使 [[UE]] power amplifier 更接近 saturation point 並提升 efficiency，降低 UE battery energy 消耗。

Low-PAPR sequence › Type 1（Release 15）
依 [[DMRS]]：

- [[Low-PAPR sequence Type 1]] 屬 [[Release 15]]。
- 使用 [[Zadoff-Chu sequence]] 或 computer-generated sequences；reference：[[3GPP TS 38.211]] Section 5.2.2。
- 用於 transform precoding enabled 時的 PUSCH DMRS sequences，且 Type 2 的條件不成立時。
- 也用於 PUCCH format 1 的 DMRS sequences，以及 PUCCH formats 3 and 4 的 DMRS sequences。
- Small sequences：1 to 5 PRBs，使用 computer-generated 或 Zadoff-Chu sequences。
- Large sequence：more than 5 PRBs，使用 Zadoff-Chu sequences。
- Zadoff-Chu sequences based on length `N_ZC_RS`，其中 `N_ZC_RS` 是小於 `M_ZC_RS` 的最大 prime number。
- 第 `N_ZC_RS` 個 sample 之後，sequence 從 beginning repeat。
- Sequences depend on group number only，not on `n_ID`。

Phase-Tracking Reference Signal (NR) › 使用限制
- [[PT-RS (NR)]] 未標示正式日期、版本或 3GPP release。
- 來源是 Rohde & Schwarz company confidential 技術筆記，不是 3GPP 正式標準全文。
- 來源引用 [[3GPP TS 38.211]]、[[3GPP TS 38.214]] 與 [[3GPP TS 38.212]] sections / tables，但未標示標準版本。
- 不能從本頁推論所有 PT-RS mapping、power scaling、threshold list 或 conformance requirement 的正式規則。

Phase-Tracking Reference Signal (NR) › Normal OFDM 限制
[[PT-RS (NR)]] 的 density configuration chapter 明示適用範圍：

- Applies to PTRS configuration of [[PDSCH]] and [[PUSCH]] in case of normal OFDM。
- `transform precoding disabled`。
- PUSCH with transform precoding 的 configuration will be added later；來源未提供內容。

Phase-Tracking Reference Signal (NR) › Time density、frequency density 與 RE offset
依 [[PT-RS (NR)]]，PT-RS 的時頻配置由 [[PTRS time and frequency density]] 描述：

- `timeDensity`：PT-RS REs on a PT-RS subcarrier 的 maximum distance；valid values 為 1、2、4 [[OFDM symbol]]s。
- `frequencyDensity`：PT-RS subcarriers 的 distance，以 RB 數計；valid values 為 2 或 4 [[Resource Block]]s。
- `resourceElementOffset`：提供 offset00、offset01、offset10、offset11 四種 frequency offsets relative to first RE of a RB；final physical RE offset also depends on associated antenna port and a look-up table。

PTRS time and frequency density › Default values 與 short allocations
依 [[PT-RS (NR)]]：

- Provided MCS / resource block threshold lists may be empty。
- In this case default values are defined in [[3GPP TS 38.214]] chapters 5.1.6.3 / 6.2.3.1。
- Downlink-only case：if neither time nor frequency threshold lists are provided by RRC, PTRS shall not be present under several conditions related to MCS tables 5.1.3.1-1、5.1.3.1-2、5.1.3.1-3；但 exact values / inequalities 被 raw 轉檔遺失。
- For both uplink or downlink, TS 38.214 says PTRS shall moreover not be present in case a special short allocation condition holds；但 exact condition 被 raw 轉檔遺失。

PTRS time and frequency density › Normal OFDM density derivation
依 [[PT-RS (NR)]]，本段 applies to PTRS configuration of [[PDSCH]] and [[PUSCH]] in case of normal OFDM：

- `transform precoding disabled`。
- PUSCH with transform precoding configuration will be added later；來源未提供。
- Higher layers do not specify time / frequency density directly for every PUSCH / PDSCH allocation。
- Instead, RRC provides a list of MCS thresholds and a list of resource block thresholds。
- Resulting time and frequency densities are derived for every allocation。

PTRS time and frequency density
[[PTRS time and frequency density]] 描述 [[Phase-Tracking Reference Signal (NR)]] 在 selected subcarriers / REs 上的 time-domain 與 frequency-domain placement density；[[PT-RS (NR)]] 只提供 normal OFDM（transform precoding disabled）下的 PDSCH / PUSCH 配置線索。

OFDM is described here as an OFDM-symbol-based waveform structure: a cyclic prefix is added to each raw OFDM symbol by copying the last samples to the front, creating a guard interval between OFDM symbols to reduce inter-symbol interference [13]. In NR, the time-domain OFDM symbols and frequency-domain subcarriers form the resource grid; one resource element is one subcarrier in one OFDM symbol on one antenna port [19]. NR sample rate is determined by the OFDM FFT size and subcarrier spacing: sampling rate = NFFT × SCS, with SCS = 2^μ × 15 kHz [16]. OFDM also matters for transmitter behavior because OFDM signals have high PAPR due to the IFFT linear combination of many random QAM symbols, which can require PA back-off to avoid clipping/distortion [27].
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding OFDM
| Decision | Rohde & Schwarz context | What depends on OFDM knowledge | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| WLAN generator/analyzer option selection | R&S CMW100-K06 WLAN options | Choosing the correct WLAN OFDM generator/analyzer option: 802.11a/g/p/n OFDM via R&S CMW-KW650, 802.11ac via CMW-KW656, 802.11ax via CMW-KW657; analyzer options include CMW-KM650/KM651/KM655/KM656/KM657 [24]. | [24] |
| WLAN bandwidth and MIMO measurement setup | R&S CMW100-K06 WLAN OFDM RF analyzer | Selecting analyzer bandwidths—20 MHz, 40 MHz, 80 MHz, 80+80 MHz, or 160 MHz depending on WLAN standard—and MIMO mode up to 8×8, including switched/composite MIMO options [24]. | [24] |
| NR sample-rate / numerology setup | NR waveform configuration used in R&S NR test context | Selecting NFFT and subcarrier spacing, because NR sample rate follows NFFT × SCS and SCS follows 2^μ × 15 kHz [16]. | [16] |
| CP / slot-symbol configuration | NR frame-structure measurements | Choosing Normal CP vs Extended CP changes OFDM symbols per slot: Normal CP uses 14 OFDM symbols per slot, Extended CP uses 12; Release 15 Extended CP is only defined for μ=2 [18]. | [18] |
| Resource-grid / allocation decisions | NR measurements and resource mapping | Understanding that an RE is one subcarrier in one OFDM symbol and one antenna port, and that RBs are 12 consecutive subcarriers, is needed for resource-grid allocation and measurement interpretation [19]. | [19] |
| OCNG allocation implementation choices | Internal R&S OCNG mapper notes, not public product spec | OCNG allocation includes configurable OFDM symbol allocation per slot, start OFDM symbol, number of symbols, PRB start/length, power setting, and RB-list/header fields including a 14-bit OFDM symbol mask [2][3]. | [2][3] |
| PT-RS density/configuration decisions | NR PDSCH/PUSCH PT-RS configuration | PT-RS density guidance applies to PDSCH/PUSCH in normal OFDM with transform precoding disabled; time density uses 1, 2, or 4 OFDM-symbol spacing, and frequency density uses 2 or 4 RB spacing [30][31][33]. | [30][31][33] |
| UL waveform / PA-efficiency decisions | NR/LTE UL waveform behavior | DFT-s-OFDM/transform precoding is used in LTE and NR UL to obtain low-PAPR UL transmit signals; low PAPR can let the UE PA operate closer to saturation and improve efficiency [26][27]. | [26][27] |
| CMX500 NR/LTE RF test planning | R&S CMX500 | CMX500 is a Rohde & Schwarz radio communication tester and one-box network emulation/measurement solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, RF parametric testing, and fading conditions [4]. | [4] |
【推論】For CMX500 LTE/NR measurements, OFDM understanding affects practical setup choices such as NR numerology, sample rate, CP, and resource-grid interpretation, because CMX500 supports LTE/NR RF parametric testing [4] and NR OFDM configuration is governed by NFFT/SCS, CP, and OFDM-symbol/subcarrier resource grids [13][16][18][19].
The provided RAW passages do not state the OFDM definition or any R&S OFDM product-option specifications; the only RAW product-context evidence supplied is a brochure pointer and a product-manager contact [39][40].

OCNG mapper › 需求摘要
[[OCNG (NR)]] 將 NR OCNG RE mapper 的需求整理如下：

- Configurable bandwidth with [[Resource Block]] resolution，supports OCNG Pattern 3 and 5。
- Start PRB and length of PRBs：0–272 and 1–273 ranges respectively。
- Configurable [[OFDM symbol]] allocation per slot，supports OCNG Pattern 4。
- Start OFDM symbol and number of symbols：0–13 and 1–14 ranges respectively。
- Power setting for OCNG allocation, similar to [[PDSCH]] format。
- Selectable awareness of other antenna's reference symbols，supports OCNG Pattern 2 and 5。
- Awareness of other antenna reference symbols implemented with extra [[CSI-RS]] allocation with zero-power。
- Data Region OCNG must be sourced from RDRAM。
- OCNG REs must be allocated last, and with lowest priority。

來源中曾提出 selectable modulation format 的問題，但也寫明 specification only specifies pseudo random [[QPSK]] modulated data；因此規格層主張仍是 QPSK。

OCNG mapper › Header / allocation format 線索
來源列出 allocation header 的可辨識欄位：

| Word | 欄位 | 來源描述 |
|---:|---|---|
| 0 | pointer / header type | next header element pointer；header type 14 = OCNG；invalid = 0xF |
| 1 | priority / number of RBs | priority 1 low to 15 high，0 not allowed；Number of RBs 1..273 |
| 2 | OFDM symbol mask | 14-bit OFDM symbol mask |
| 3 | OCNG Power factor | 0x8000 = 1 |
| 4/5 | data pointer / RAM / layers / modulation | OCNG Data pointer；RAM Select 0=PDRAM, 1=FDRAM, 3=RDRAM default；Number of layers / ports minus 1 range 0 to 3；Modulation Type 2=QPSK, 3=QAM16, 4=QAM64, 5=QAM256 |

來源也說 RB List extension elements provide a list of PRB numbers in the order of mapping：

- At least one RB set is required to provide overall OCNG mapping。
- At least one RB is required。
- Each extension element can hold up to 16 RB numbers。
- More extension elements can be added if more RB numbers are needed。
- Unused words in the last extension element should be set to 0xFFFF。
- Number of RBs in the header must match number of RBs in the RB list。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

NR cyclic prefix › 基本概念
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- 在 OFDM system 中，CP is added for each OFDM symbol in time-domain。
- CP 是把 raw OFDM symbol 最後幾個 samples 複製到 raw OFDM symbol 前方。
- CP provides a guard interval between two OFDM symbols。
- CP 用於 eliminate inter-symbol interference, ISI。
- NR defines two types of cyclic prefix lengths：[[Normal CP]] 與 [[Extended CP]]。

NR sample rate › Sample rate 公式
來源給出的 NR sample rate calculation：

- Sampling rate in samples/sec = number of samples per raw OFDM symbol / duration of one raw OFDM symbol。
- Sampling rate = NFFT / (1 / SCS)。
- Sampling rate = NFFT × SCS。
- SCS = 2^μ × 15 kHz。
- 因此 sampling rate = NFFT × 2^μ × 15 kHz。

5G NR frame structure › OFDM symbols per slot
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- [[Normal CP]] 使用 14 [[OFDM symbol]]s per slot。
- [[Extended CP]] 使用 12 [[OFDM symbol]]s per slot。
- 來源明示在 NR Release 15 中，[[Extended CP]] only defined for numerology μ=2。

5G NR frame structure › 與 resource grid 的關係
Frame / subframe / slot / symbol 是 time-domain structure；[[NR resource grid]] 則把 time-domain [[OFDM symbol]] 與 frequency-domain subcarriers 組成 grid。

- [[Resource Element]] 是 one subcarrier in one OFDM symbol and on one antenna port。
- [[Resource Block]] 是 12 consecutive subcarriers。
- [[Point-A]] 是 resource grid starts toward higher frequencies 的 frequency-domain reference。

R&S CMW100 K06 › WLAN
- WLAN RF generator standards 與 options：IEEE 802.11a/g/p/n OFDM、IEEE 802.11b/g DSSS 使用 R&S®CMW-KW650；IEEE 802.11ac 使用 R&S®CMW-KW656；IEEE 802.11ax 使用 R&S®CMW-KW657。
- WLAN generator bandwidth：up to 160 MHz。
- WLAN generator frequency range：2.4 GHz band 2412 MHz to 2484 MHz；5 GHz band 5000 MHz to 6000 MHz，prerequisite R&S®CMW-K046 option。
- WLAN OFDM RF analyzer options：IEEE 802.11a/g R&S®CMW-KM650；IEEE 802.11n R&S®CMW-KM651；IEEE 802.11p R&S®CMW-KM655；IEEE 802.11ac R&S®CMW-KM656；IEEE 802.11ax R&S®CMW-KM657。
- WLAN OFDM MIMO：composite MIMO R&S®CMW-KM652；switched MIMO R&S®CMW-KM653。
- WLAN OFDM RF analyzer bandwidth：802.11a/g 20 MHz；802.11n 20 MHz / 40 MHz；802.11p 5 MHz / 10 MHz / 20 MHz；802.11ac/ax 20 MHz / 40 MHz / 80 MHz / 80+80 MHz / 160 MHz。
- WLAN OFDM RF analyzer MIMO：switched 與 composite，最高 8 × 8。

Low-PAPR sequence › Transform precoding 與 π/2-BPSK
依 [[DMRS]]：

- [[DFT-s-OFDM]] 也稱為 [[Transform precoding]]，在 LTE 與 NR 的 UL 中啟用，用於取得 low-PAPR UL transmit signal。
- Transform precoding 中 modulation symbols 先經 DFT-precoded，再輸入 OFDM modulator。
- DFT 與 OFDM modulator 的 IFFT block effectively cancels one another，因此移除 OFDM modulator 的 high-PAPR effect。
- 使用 low-PAPR modulation symbols 可進一步降低 UL transmit signal 的 PAPR。
- NR 中 UL transmission with transform precoding 啟用 [[π-2-BPSK]] modulation。
- [[π-2-BPSK]] 產生 low-PAPR waveform，因為 symbol-to-symbol transition 不會穿越 constellation 的 zero-amplitude point。

Low-PAPR sequence › 背景：為什麼需要 low-PAPR
依 [[DMRS]]：

- OFDM signals 具有 high peak-to-average power ratio（PAPR），因為由 many random QAM symbols 的 linear combination（IFFT）形成。
- High-PAPR signal 需要 transmitter back-off power amplifier operating point，以避免 transmit signal 進入 power amplifier saturation region 而 clipped / distorted。
- Power amplifier 遠離 saturation point 操作時 efficiency drops。
- DL signals 由連接 power grid 的 base station 傳送，因此 high-PAPR 在 DL 不 critical；NR uses OFDM for DL signals。
- NR 與 LTE 不同，NR UL 也允許使用 OFDM signals。
- UL 可能需要 low-PAPR signal，使 [[UE]] power amplifier 更接近 saturation point 並提升 efficiency，降低 UE battery energy 消耗。

Phase-Tracking Reference Signal (NR) › Normal OFDM 限制
[[PT-RS (NR)]] 的 density configuration chapter 明示適用範圍：

- Applies to PTRS configuration of [[PDSCH]] and [[PUSCH]] in case of normal OFDM。
- `transform precoding disabled`。
- PUSCH with transform precoding 的 configuration will be added later；來源未提供內容。

Phase-Tracking Reference Signal (NR) › Time density、frequency density 與 RE offset
依 [[PT-RS (NR)]]，PT-RS 的時頻配置由 [[PTRS time and frequency density]] 描述：

- `timeDensity`：PT-RS REs on a PT-RS subcarrier 的 maximum distance；valid values 為 1、2、4 [[OFDM symbol]]s。
- `frequencyDensity`：PT-RS subcarriers 的 distance，以 RB 數計；valid values 為 2 或 4 [[Resource Block]]s。
- `resourceElementOffset`：提供 offset00、offset01、offset10、offset11 四種 frequency offsets relative to first RE of a RB；final physical RE offset also depends on associated antenna port and a look-up table。

PTRS time and frequency density › Normal OFDM density derivation
依 [[PT-RS (NR)]]，本段 applies to PTRS configuration of [[PDSCH]] and [[PUSCH]] in case of normal OFDM：

- `transform precoding disabled`。
- PUSCH with transform precoding configuration will be added later；來源未提供。
- Higher layers do not specify time / frequency density directly for every PUSCH / PDSCH allocation。
- Instead, RRC provides a list of MCS thresholds and a list of resource block thresholds。
- Resulting time and frequency densities are derived for every allocation。
